changeSet.author: adhesion
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE shop_supplier_orders ( id bigint GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, supplier_name varchar(200) NOT NULL, supplier_reference varchar(100), status varchar(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ORDERED', received_at timestamp with time zone, created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL, updated_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT ck_shop_supplier_order_status CHECK (status IN ('ORDERED', 'RECEIVED')), CONSTRAINT ck_shop_supplier_order_supplier CHECK (char_length(trim(supplier_name)) > 0) );

changeSet.author: adhesion
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE shop_supplier_order_lines ( id bigint GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, order_id bigint NOT NULL REFERENCES shop_supplier_orders(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, variant_id bigint NOT NULL, product_name varchar(200) NOT NULL, variant_name varchar(160), sku varchar(100) NOT NULL, quantity integer NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT ck_shop_supplier_line_quantity CHECK (quantity > 0), CONSTRAINT uk_shop_supplier_order_variant UNIQUE (order_id, variant_id) );

changeSet.author: adhesion
changeSet.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_shop_supplier_order_status_created ON shop_supplier_orders (status, created_at);
